info.background_text:
The love-spreading idol.
While given the title of archpriest, Diana does not have the same authority as others of her stature, making her closer to an honorary member. People often regard the Holy Crusaders as a rigid and silent order, but Diana serves as the figurehead who defies that image. All for the happiness of others, and for the sake of love.
